card.title: 'Agentic AI for retail' spans grocers, formats and 4 languages — but lands everywhere the same
card.body: Your top LinkedIn message runs across Save A Lot, Albertsons, pan-European assortment and APAC (NRF), in English, Spanish, German and French — yet every click lands on the same destination. The region and format that's converting can't be told apart from the one that isn't.
card.move: Split the top-converting region/format (APAC grocery, EU assortment) onto its own page and measure pipeline separately; retire the flat variants.
card.impact: See which retail play actually produces pipeline

sections.heading: Point the agents at a goal. Agents run the rest.
sections.body: Set a goal in your own terms — cost-per-opportunity for Retail, pipeline for Summit by region — and the agent works out what to watch and what to do, on your numbers.

goals.text: Find which retail region and format actually convert — and move budget there.
goals.result: Agents measure each market and language on its own, and shift spend toward the plays that produce pipeline, not just engagement.

goals.text: Give Summit its own read, not a blended one.
goals.result: Agents separate the ITSM Google program from Retail LinkedIn so each division sees its true cost-per-opportunity.

steps.title: Monitor

sections.heading: Always know your next move.

cards.title: APAC retail creatives convert to opportunity at 2.4× the EU set — but share the same flat budget
cards.body: Your NRF/APAC grocery ads pull enterprise retail accounts that reach opportunity far above the pan-European assortment set, yet the budget split across regions hasn't moved in 90 days and the flat multi-language variants keep spending.
cards.move: Shift 20% of the flat regional budget toward APAC grocery, give it an intent-matched page, and pause the multi-language variants with no opportunity in 90 days.

cards.title: 14 enterprise accounts engaged both Retail LinkedIn and Summit Google — none routed to either team
cards.body: Over 14 days, 14 enterprise accounts engaged your Retail agentic-AI ads and your Summit ITSM ads, and reached pricing — but never entered the CRM for either division. Cross-division intent that both teams are blind to.
cards.move: Route each account to the right division as a named list, and suppress from cold prospecting so spend targets the open motion.
